children.doc: Resting states: waiting for the next issue.
Decide, based on the datamodel, what happens to the issue.
In accepting; reacts to github.label.done, github.label.error
Comment and label concurrently; close once both are finished.
In closing; reacts to github.close.done, github.close.error
The allowlist can be edited at any time without disturbing the current issue.

root.doc: One machine and one I/O processor: closes issues from people who aren't on the allowlist.

datamodel.doc: GitHub logins whose issues stay open. Everybody else is closed.
Issues that arrived while another one was being handled, oldest first.
